concerns: The reading for 聴 (き) is incorrect. The standard reading for this kanji when used alone or as the first kanji in a compound is チョウ (chou), as seen in 聴診 (ちょうしん). While きく is a valid reading for the verb 聞く/聴く, the kanji 聴 itself is not typically read as き in isolation or as a single kanji component in this context.
